_nota: Pasada 2 del 522 (orden del dueño 23/11 22:27): Rosa con voz de biblioteca de España (la diseñada sonaba sudamericana) y Jambo con voz nueva, más lenta y arrastrando las eses.

escenas.v: ¡Buah! Eso es el contador, Rosa. De noche cuenta doble. Lo sé de buena tinta.

jambo.descripcion: A scrawny, worn-out man in his late 40s who sounds much older, from a rough working-class barrio. He speaks European Spanish from Madrid, Spain: peninsular Castilian accent with the Spanish 'th' sound for z and c, uses 'vosotros' and 'vale'. Never Latin American, never Portuguese. Very slow, sleepy, drawling street speech: he drags and lengthens his words, stretches and hisses every S sound, slurs his consonants and trails off as if half asleep. Hoarse, raspy, broken, nasal voice. A wheedling, shameless scrounger who suddenly wakes up when he wants something.

rosa.descripcion: A woman in her early 50s who runs a small business. She speaks European Spanish from Madrid, Spain: peninsular Castilian accent with the Spanish 'th' sound for z and c, uses 'vosotros' and 'vale'. Never Latin American, never Portuguese. Medium-low, slightly husky, commanding voice; bossy, theatrical and affected, sweet on the surface and sharp underneath. Confident, quick delivery.
